def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw = params.get("id")

def _mask_email(email: str) -> str:
    local, sep, domain = email.partition("@")

    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, {"masked": _mask_email(user["email"])}
